Topic 1.2: Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUSOMA 1.2.1 KUSOMA KWA UFAHAMU KIFUNGU CHA SIMULIZI
This lesson teaches Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi for Grade 7 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Describe Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi above.
2. Explain Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha simulizi
